text_block_list.text:
On my way back from a day out with
Super
Creek...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We ended up walking quite a lot today.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Are you okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Still full of pep, huh?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
In that case... do you mind tagging along
with me
for just a little longer?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Let's go and rest somewhere quiet...
What do you
say?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: How about we grab a cup of tea?

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I learned a reeeally refreshing
massage
technique recently.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking I'd give it a try on you,

Trainer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to be shy! Let's go
somewhere
you can lie down.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I'm all changed!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... Oguri?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Creek. You're with your trainer,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, you're still training at this
hour?
Well, aren't you a go-getter!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard though.
Taking the
time to rest is equally
important.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's what I was about to do.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I don't know if it's because I
exercised
differently than usual, but my
body feels a little
stiff...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Hm? Let me take a look.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Trainer, help me out here, will you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Upon Супер Крик's request, I take a
look at
Oguri Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like there's anything to
be worried
about, but it might be good
to loosen up her
muscles a bit with a
massage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look serious, but what do you
think,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: It might be good to loosen up those muscles.

text_block_list.text: Well! Then it's my time to shine!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: You know how to give a massage?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
The intricate stuff is best left to the
professionals,
but I can manage if you're
just looking to loosen
up a little.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll squeeze the pressure points in your
feet too.
It's super effective, even if it
does hurt a lot.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. Could you wait here for a
bit?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
Massages are best received after warming up
your body.

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. Could you wait here for a
bit?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
Massages are best received after warming up
your body.

text_block_list.text: Yep, I agree.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Okay, Oguri. First, let's hit to the
showers
together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Um... But I was going to train again after
a short
rest...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
That's enough for today. Be a darling
and come
along, why don't you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: B-but...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: We'll be back, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Without getting a say on the matter,
Oguri Cap is
dragged off by Super
Creek.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Now then, Oguri. Lay down over there.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll bear the pain if I have to. I just hope
there
won't be any lingering discomfort.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! You'll feel all refreshed once
I'm done
with you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I hear some strange noises coming from
the
showers shortly thereafter. They
vaguely sound
like screams, but... I'm
probably just imagining
things.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mere seconds later, I hear Огури Кэп
shriek as
she gets her feet massaged.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
